{{Short description|Russian-American mathematician}}
[[File:Boris Mityagin, 2010 (cropped).jpg|thumb|Boris Mityagin, [[Oberwolfach Research Institute for Mathematics|Oberwolfach]] 2010]]
'''Boris Samuel Mityagin''' (Борис Самуилович Митягин, born 12 August 1937, [[Voronezh]])<ref>birth and career data from ''American Men and Women of Science'', Thomson Gale 2004</ref> is a Russian-American mathematician.

Mityagin received in 1961 his candidate degree (Ph.D.) under [[Georgiy Shilov]] at the [[Moscow State University]]<ref>{{MathGenealogyProject|id=11652}}</ref> and in 1963 his Russian doctorate (higher doctoral degree). He was a researcher at the [[Central Economic Mathematical Institute]] of the [[Soviet Academy of Sciences]]. In 1979 he became a professor at [[Ohio State University]].

His research deals with functional analysis and mathematical physics (spectra of Schrödinger and Dirac operators).

In 1966 in Moscow he was (with [[Aleksander Pełczyński|A. Pełczyński]]) an Invited Speaker of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians|ICM]].<ref>{{cite book|editor=Aizerman, M. A.|author=Ibragimov, I. A.|author2=Pełczyński, A.|chapter=Nuclear approximation and approximative dimension|title=Thirty-one invited addresses at the International Congress of Mathematicians in Moscow in 1966|series=American Mathematical Society Translations, Series 2, Vol. 70|pages=137–145|publisher=American Mathematical Soc.|year=1968|isbn=9780821896457|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=3xQpXJ_hmBMC}}</ref>

In 1960 he received the prize of the [[Moscow Mathematical Society]]. In 2013 he was elected a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society http://www.ams.org/cgi-bin/fellows/fellows.cgi#m</ref>

==Selected publications==
* Approximate dimension and bases in nuclear spaces, Russian Mathematical Surveys, vol. 16, 1961, pp.&nbsp;59–127
* with [[Albert S. Schwarz]]: Functors in categories of Banach spaces, Russian Mathematical Surveys, vol. 19, 1964, pp.&nbsp;65–127
* An interpolation theorem for modular spaces, Matematicheskii Sbornik, vol. 108, 1965, pp.&nbsp;473–482
* The homotopy structure of the linear group of a Banach space, Russian Mathematical Surveys, vol. 25, 1970, pp.&nbsp;59–103
* Equivalence of bases in Hilbert spaces, Studia Mathematica, vol. 37, 1971, p.&nbsp;111
* with G. M. Henkin: Linear problems of complex analysis, Russian Mathematical Surveys, vol. 26,  1971, pp.&nbsp;99–164
* Notes on mathematical economics, Russian Mathematical Surveys, vol. 27, 1972, pp.&nbsp;1–19
* with [[Mikhail Kadets|M. I. Kadets]]: Complemented subspaces in Banach spaces, Russian Mathematical Surveys, vol. 28, 1973, pp.&nbsp;77–95
* with E. M. Semenov: Lack of interpolation of linear operators in spaces of smooth functions, Mathematics of the USSR-Izvestiya, vol. 11, 1977, pp.&nbsp;1229–1266
* Quadratic pencils and least-squares piecewise-polynomial approximation, Math. Comp., vol. 40, 1983, pp.&nbsp;283–300 {{doi|10.1090/S0025-5718-1983-0679446-0}}
* with I. Aharoni and Bernard Maurey: Uniform embeddings of metric spaces and of Banach spaces into Hilbert spaces, [[Israel Journal of Mathematics]], vol. 52, 1985, pp.&nbsp;251–265
* with [[Vitaly Bergelson]] and {{ill|Isaac Kornfeld|de|Issaak Pawlowitsch Kornfeld}}: Unitary ''Z''<sup> d</sup>-actions with continuous spectrum, [[Proc. Amer. Math. Soc.]], vol. 119, 1993, pp.&nbsp;1127–1134 {{doi|10.1090/S0002-9939-1993-1145413-4}}
* with [[Thomas Kappeler]]: Gap estimates of the spectrum of Hill's equation and action variables for ''KdV''. [[Trans. Amer. Math. Soc.]], vol. 351, 1999, 619–646 {{doi|10.1090/S0002-9947-99-02186-8}}
* with Thomas Kappeler: Estimates for periodic and Dirichlet eigenvalues of the Schrödinger operator, SIAM journal on mathematical analysis, vol. 33, 2001, pp.&nbsp;113–152
* Spectral expansions of one-dimensional periodic Dirac operators, Dyn. Partial Diff. Eq., vol. 1, 2004, pp.&nbsp;125–191
* with Plamen Diakov: Instability zones of periodic 1-dimensional Schrödinger and Dirac operators, Russian Mathematical Surveys, vol. 61, 2006, p.&nbsp;663
